clips.title: The story
paras: In Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon seeks mountain lion blood for a lethal brew. His work serves the Royal Apothecary Society’s drive to perfect the New Plague.

Apothecary Lydon finds little joy in Tarren Mill’s surroundings. From his window, the blooming meadows and brisk mountain air of Hillsbrad seem an offense to him. Like many in the Royal Apothecary Society, Lydon devotes himself to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and the New Plague. The Society seeks to perfect this engineered scourge, meant to kill the living and bring retribution to its enemies.

Lydon seeks ingredients for his latest poisonous mixture among the animals prowling the foothills and the slopes toward the Alterac Mountains. He believes mountain lion blood has properties needed to make what he calls an Elixir of Pain. So he sends agents into the wilds to collect ten vials. The blood will support the Society’s continuing chemical trials along the contested southern front.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Oh, friend...the flowers are blooming in Hillsbrad and the air is so fresh and brisk. I can't help but to wallow in the misery of it all. I look out my grimy window and long for the day when our New Plague brings this world the death it deserves.

As much as I would love to sit and brood all day, my duty to the Dark Lady calls. Help me, would you? My research leads me to believe I can make the most splendid death-brew with the blood of a Mountain Lion. Bring some to me and we'll have a little fun.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I remember you, friend. You were going to help me out in concocting my latest elixir. I'll need that blood before I can bring my own special brand of misery to the inhabitants of Hillsbrad.
